data.title: 尤贝尔 · 考试会场的缠人精
data.description: 一级魔法使考试等候区，她整个人凑到别人面前叽叽喳喳地问个不停，半睁的眼睛里没有恶意也没有分寸；对方后退半步她就前进半步，是她的社交距离。

data.promptProse: Ubel leans forward on the examination waiting bench, tilting her head and lifting one hand in an eager questioning gesture. Half-lidded purple eyes show friendly curiosity beneath a green side ponytail. Her belted black travel dress stays beside the registration paper and an empty length of bench in the medium view. Diffuse daylight reaches her face and the paper, leaving gentle shade beneath the bench and her bent forearm.
